evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official Liverpool City Region Investment Zone tax-site page identifies Daresbury as one of the three designated tax sites, states that the Liverpool City Region tax sites took effect on 8 April 2024, and describes the Daresbury special tax site as land around Sci-Tech business park at the junction of the A558 Daresbury Expressway and A56 Chester Road. The Designation of Special Tax Sites (Liverpool City Region, West Midlands and North East Investment Zones) Regulations 2024 identify the legal area by the map titled 'Liverpool City Region Combined Authority - Daresbury Tax Site' dated 19 January 2024.
